title: La última gota
logline: En un invernadero que se seca al amanecer, un jardinero y su aprendiz tienen que encontrar agua antes de que la última planta cierre.

beats.line: La última hoja llevaba tres días pidiendo agua.
beats.speaker: narrator
beats.cameraMotive: start on the dry plant and the empty can: the problem is visible before anyone explains it
beats.transitionMotive: open on the object that carries the need, not on an establishing shot
beats.note: hook: the dry leaf and the empty can, no actor, no exposition of the room

beats.line: El jardinero abrió el grifo; solo salió aire.
beats.speaker: narrator
beats.cameraMotive: tilt from the dry tap to the gardener's face, so the failed gesture has a reaction
beats.transitionMotive: the object problem becomes a person trying to solve it
beats.note: setup: the tap fails; the gardener's reach is the first action, not a pose

beats.line: El aprendiz trajo la regadera vacía.
beats.speaker: narrator
beats.cameraMotive: follow the apprentice entering with the can, keeping the dry plant in the same frame
beats.transitionMotive: a second person enters the problem; the can changes hands at the cut

actors.continuityMotive: first appearance with the can; the cut shows the object already in hand

beats.note: escalation: the empty can is the obstacle made visible; no long explanation

beats.line: Al fondo, el barril de lluvia seguía lleno.
beats.speaker: narrator
beats.cameraMotive: scan from the dry bench to the rain barrel, revealing the available water without a new location
beats.transitionMotive: the solution is in the same room; the camera finds it
beats.note: development: the decision is spatial; the barrel is revealed and the apprentice turns toward it

beats.line: El aprendiz cruzó el invernadero con la regadera llena.
beats.speaker: narrator
beats.cameraMotive: reframe around the walk until the plant, the can and the gardener share the frame
beats.transitionMotive: the second action moves the story from decision to consequence
beats.note: action: the carried can moves 140 px, under the teleport guard; the reach is the pour

beats.speaker: none
beats.cameraMotive: hold the gardener's face while the plant takes the water; the reaction is the consequence
beats.transitionMotive: hard cut to the person who has been waiting for the plant to answer

actors.continuityMotive: hard cut to a close-up inside the same greenhouse; no stage move

beats.note: reaction: wordless close-up; the plant's change is the cause

beats.line: La planta bebió; la flor abrió.
beats.speaker: narrator
beats.cameraMotive: release from the plant as the flower opens, leaving the room that made the change possible
beats.transitionMotive: settle on the visible result; no new information after this
beats.note: close: the plant blooms; the object changed state, not only the narration
